# Sandi Bates, Broker

> > A Utah-based real estate brokerage specializing in residential property listings and home sales across the greater Salt Lake Valley region.

Sandi Bates is a real estate broker serving Utah communities including Lehi, Herriman, American Fork, and Saratoga Springs. The site provides active residential property listings and home search resources for buyers and sellers in the Utah Lake area.
